name: eq-strings
description: Ensemble weight vs edge, violin bow and harmonics. Fast passages need edge, lush beds need weight.
notes: Precondition: Strings track selected in Cubase, insert 0 loaded per opencode/reference/eq-strings.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Bow lift in the upper-mid (~0.6); low shelf / body / harmonics manually by resolved title.
Dry by design: no send.set calls; study stays upfront.
